content.text: Task (syswatch T3 per SYSWATCH_PLAN.md): implement history graph rendering in the existing ANSI TUI (do NOT rewrite to ratatui — keep current ui.rs style). 1) Load JSONL snapshot logs from the syswatch log dir (reuse the log_dir() resolution in src/logging.rs — expose it pub(crate); logs live in C:/ProgramData/syswatch/logs or %LOCALAPPDATA%/syswatch/logs). 2) Add a history view (e.g. 'h' key in live view OR a --history flag — pick whichever keeps the diff smallest, but it must be reachable without config changes) showing sparkline graphs of cpu.total_pct and memory.pct from the log file, with a date/time axis label (HH:MM ticks; day boundary marked). 3) Day/week zoom: keys to switch between last 24h (5-min buckets) and last 7 days (hourly buckets), and a way to pick which day file when multiple exist (default: today). 4) q quits the history view back to live. Handle missing/empty log files with a friendly message, not a panic. The Snapshot struct is in src/stats.rs (serde deserialize from JSONL — verify field names match the real sample: {"timestamp":"2026-08-24T08:30:39Z","cpu":{"total_pct":...},"memory":{"pct":...},...}). Sample data for testing: C:/ProgramData/syswatch/logs/2026-08-24.jsonl (3547 lines). Rules: minimal diff, no unrelated changes, no features beyond the ask; verify with cargo build + cargo test before finishing; keep it compiling on stable Rust.
